bar.gain_rule: rung 8 minus rung 7 for the model on the real-family rows, with the 95 percent paired cluster-bootstrap interval over the scored real chunks (0024's resamples: the same generator construction, seed and draw order): the interval's 97.5th percentile below 0 is FOURTH_DOUBLING_FALLS; else a gain >= 0.005 with the 2.5th percentile above 0 is FOURTH_DOUBLING_RISES; else a 2.5th percentile above 0 is FOURTH_DOUBLING_BELOW_RATE; otherwise FOURTH_DOUBLING_NOT_RESOLVED (never 'flat', never 'equal'). The interval covers the resampling of the 1488 scored real chunks of five files only, not the draw of rung 8's plaintexts nor the fit side. If the model at rung 8 or at rung 7 is at its iteration cap, the reading is still read by the rule as is (the cap is part of the sealed recipe and is never raised), the verdict string is still emitted, every document that states it states '(the model at its iteration cap at rung N)' in the same sentence, and the gain is not quoted as a recipe reading; a BELOW_RATE, NOT_RESOLVED or FALLS with the model at cap is published as such
bar.lead_rule: the 95 percent paired cluster-bootstrap interval of model minus logistic real-family top-1 at rung 8 (the top rung), over the scored real chunks with the slope bootstrap's own resamples: entirely above 0 is MODEL_LEADS, entirely below 0 is LINEAR_LEADS, otherwise NO_SEPARATION (never 'equal'); the verdict string carries it as a suffix. If the model or the logistic at rung 8 (the top rung) is at its iteration cap, the suffix is still read by the rule, but every document that states it states '(the <role> at its iteration cap at rung 8 (the top rung))' in the same sentence and the lead is not quoted as a recipe comparison, exactly as the difference flag is not

bootstrap.rule: cluster bootstrap over the SCORED real-family chunks with 0024's generator construction, seed and draw order (np.random.default_rng(seed2)): one resample of chunks serves every rung and every role, so differences between rungs (the fourth-doubling gain) and between roles (the lead) are paired; accuracies inside a resample are rounded to 4 decimals; the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles are the interval. Because the seed, the chunk set and the code are 0024's, 0024's second-decade slope intervals and its rung-7 and rung-4 lead intervals recompute here to 0024's banked values exactly (a reproduction clause). The interval is over the scored chunks only: it does not resample the fit side, the draw of rung 8's plaintexts, or where early stopping halted.

fit2_corpus_described.disjointness: by bytes and at every offset: every candidate chunk is dropped if it equals any whole chunk of any 0018 pinned blob or shares a run of 1024 bytes with one at any alignment; `corpus_realfit2.py --disjoint` proves the exclusion set covers every real source hash of 0018's sealed corpus and of 0021's fit corpus, that this corpus shares no chunk id and no source hash with either, and re-scans every built chunk for the run rule; the runner re-measures chunk ids, source hashes and byte-identical feature rows against everything scored and against 0021's block. What is NOT excluded, stated: runs shorter than 1024 bytes (boilerplate lines, short code sequences) and text that revises a scored document without copying a kilobyte of it verbatim; RFCs related to a 0018-pinned RFC by an Obsoletes or Updates annotation were removed from the sample for that reason
